summary: In a servlet, calling System.exit(1) terminates the entire JVM/web container, which is the CWE-382 defect. The sink is reached whenever the condition is true (IO.STATIC_FINAL_FIVE == 5, always true). The fix keeps the conditional control flow intact but replaces the JVM-killing call with a benign, non-terminating action (logging), so the servlet continues to function and still responds normally instead of shutting down the container.
